# Go-No-Go 1 - Investing GA

**Date:** Tuesday Sep 29, 60 min
**Attendees:** Renee Alvarez (chair), Maya Chen, Aleks Varga, Hana Ito, Marcus Bell, Devon Park, Nadia Okafor, Lin Zhao, Kavi Raman
**Pre-read:** Investing Beta - Week 3 Readout, Investing Launch Checklist

## Question on the table

Do we take investing from the 5% beta to GA on Oct 6 as planned?

## Outcome

**NO-GO.** Unanimous. New GA target Oct 20, with go/no-go #2 on Oct 16.

Decision: Investing does not go GA on Oct 6. New target Oct 20, gated on go/no-go #2 on Oct 16 (Renee, Maya, Aleks).

## Blockers

| # | Blocker | Owner | Status Sep 29 | Needed by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | Position reconciliation fix for fractional shares after corporate actions | Devon Park | Design done, code not in review | Oct 14 |
| B2 | Disclosures final review | Hana Ito | Final copy received Sep 26; review in progress | Oct 9 |
| B3 | Android parity on 2 screens (order confirmation, performance detail) | Nadia Okafor | In progress | Oct 15 |

## Discussion

**Reconciliation (Devon).** 46 positions, 0.4% of the total, are off by fractional shares after a stock split in one ETF's underlying holding. The fix changes how we apply DriveWealth corporate-action adjustments and adds a reconciliation step that compares post-action quantities to the vendor file before we display them. Devon wants the fix plus two clean daily reconciliation runs before GA. Maya agreed and asked that we not shortcut it: "we just had a money-movement incident; this is not the week to ship a reconciliation fix untested."

**Disclosures (Hana).** Hana is reviewing final copy now. No blocking concerns expected; the order confirmation wording needs one more change. She'll sign by Oct 9 at the latest.

**Android (Nadia).** Parity on two screens is the remaining gap. One Android engineer on it. Nadia has asked Theo Brandt to pick up iOS bug fixes so she can review Android work herself.

**Sep 26 incident.** Aleks asked whether the round-up incident affects GA. Marcus: different system, no investing funding path involved. But it means Marcus and Devon are both pulled into follow-ups this week, and Pillar Bank will want to know GA timing at the QBR on Oct 2.

**Kavi** raised that growth experiments are still frozen and that every week of slip extends the freeze. Renee: acknowledged, will revisit criteria after GA (Growth Experiments - Freeze During Beta).

## Non-blocking items to finish before GA

- Support macro for corrected positions.
- Help copy for T+1 settlement and the funding cap (ticket rate still above target).
- GA ramp plan.

Risk: Devon is on both the reconciliation fix and the Sep 26 follow-ups. If either grows, GA moves again.

Risk: Pillar Bank asks to delay GA until the Sep 26 remediation plan is accepted.

Open question: Do we notify the owners of the 46 affected positions before or after the fix? Hana leaning "after, with the corrected numbers," to avoid two messages.

**Update Oct 7:** B2 cleared, Hana signed the disclosures today. B1 and B3 still open; agenda for go/no-go #2 to follow.

## Action items

- [ ] Devon: land position reconciliation fix by 2026-10-14
- [x] Hana: sign disclosures final review by 2026-10-09 (signed Oct 7)
- [ ] Nadia: ship Android parity for the two investing screens by 2026-10-15
- [ ] Renee: run go/no-go #2 by 2026-10-16
- [x] Renee: tell beta users GA is coming "in October" by 2026-09-30
- [x] Maya: brief Karim Haddad on GA timing at the QBR by 2026-10-02
